items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 4 at 8:54PM PDT until September 6 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt expected.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...From 9 AM to 9 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 4 at 9:03PM PDT until September 7 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Increased risk of sneaker waves and strong rip currents
due to incoming long period southerly swell associated with
tropical activity in the Eastern Pacific Ocean. Breaking waves
to around 10 feet expected.

* WHERE...Pacific Coast beaches.

* WHEN...Through 11 PM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous conditions are forecast along the
shoreline. Hazards include sneaker waves, strong rip currents,
and large breaking waves.
items.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.
